confidence_notes: Recent city-level cost-of-living data supports the meal, cappuccino, and domestic draft beer estimates, though Sanya price samples vary. Cocktail and wine-glass estimates use their local price relationship to draft beer because reliable citywide glass-price data was not available. Accommodation anchors are bounded off-peak estimates; resort seasonality creates substantial uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: No direct comparable city was needed for food and drink because Sanya city-level price data was available. Accommodation estimates reflect a Chinese coastal resort market with strong seasonal variation.
